_about: Chloroform (1) + methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set without ionic liquid from Li et al. (2014). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of chloroform, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of chloroform.

source.citation: Q. Li, L. Cao, Y. Zhang, P. Liu, B. Wang, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for Chloroform + Methanol + 1,3-Dimethylimidazolium Dimethylphosphate at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 59 (2014) 234-239
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1 (boiling temperature) and 2 (vapour mole fraction): the binary chloroform + methanol set without ionic liquid. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties given in the ThermoML record: T 0.2-0.3 K, y_1 0.007-0.011. The pure-component temperatures (334.1 K chloroform, 337.9 K methanol) differ from the normal boiling points in components.json by -0.25 K and +0.27 K. The ThermoML record carries no consistency-test result; validation/python/fit_parameters.py runs a point test (Van Ness / Fredenslund type) and prints it. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical.
